reason: `is_safe_url("https://example.org/\npath")` removes the newline and returns true, and `sanitize_markdown_link` similarly strips it before validation and emits a link. Reject control characters in the original URL before any sanitization, and add a regression test.
target_issue: Req 1: reject URLs containing whitespace control characters
thoughts: I’ll inspect the actual diff before deciding, since the completion report and advisory brief are not substitutes for checking the implementation.

The implementation strips control characters before validating the URL, so a URL containing a control byte can become safe and be emitted as a Markdown link. That contradicts Req 1’s explicit requirement to reject URLs containing whitespace control characters; the added tests do not cover this case.
